newsitem.title: USA: PSNH sees coal unit restarting Dec 15.
newsitem.headline: PSNH sees coal unit restarting Dec 15.

text.p: Public Service of New Hampshire said Wednesday it has further delayed the restart of its 345 megawatt Merrimack coal-fired unit 2 to December 15.
"It was supposed to restart on November 22. There was a connection problem in the generator," a company spokeswoman said.
The unit, located near Bow, in central New Hampshire, was shut October 25 for boiler maintenance. A new restart date of December 9 had been set in late November.
Separately, the utility said about 15,500 of its electricity customers were still without service in New Hampshire following Sunday's heavy snow storm.
Public Service of New Hampshire is a unit of Northeast Utilities.
